name: Finding the Shadowy Figure
label: Quest
description: Sven Yorgen's farm has been devastated, and Finding the Shadowy Figure turns toward the stranger who fled it. Tavernkeep Smitts points the search west…
intro: Sven Yorgen's farm has been devastated, and Finding the Shadowy Figure turns toward the stranger who fled it. Tavernkeep Smitts points the search west from Darkshire into Duskwood's haunted woods.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Good luck, friend. I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive.
If he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Who are you?? Leave me be!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I'm the author of that book. You finally found me, eh?
Well if you read that journal...then you only know the half of it!
